Part 6 — Live edits to the database (the answer to your direct question)

Q: "Allow for any live edits to the database to be made."

You have three live-edit surfaces today, in order of safety:

6.1 The admin UI (Tier 1 — the answer for 95% of "I need to change X right now")

Every field on every page in §3 is editable in real time. Click row → modal → edit → Save → the change is in the database in under 2 seconds.

This is what you should use unless the change can't be done one record at a time.

6.2 Supabase Studio (Tier 2 — for bulk + corrective edits)

https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/uapxakmlwnpfsftfeezx → SQL editor.

Used for: bulk corrections, fixing a column on many rows, cleaning up bad data after an import.

Rules already in §4.2 — re-read them every time before clicking Run.

6.3 Supabase MCP via Claude (Tier 2.5 — fast, conversational, still risky)

You already have the Supabase MCP server connected to Claude Code. From any session you can say:

"Run SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE status = 'active'"

and Claude will execute it via the MCP tools. This is the same risk profile as Tier 2 — it's direct SQL, no app validation, no audit log. Use the same rules. The advantage is speed for one-off questions ("how many active rentals do we have right now?") without opening Studio.

What you should NOT do

  • ❌ Build a generic "edit any table" admin page. It's a footgun: the more flexibility it has, the more damage one click can do, and you have no audit trail. The structured admin UI already covers every record-level edit.
  • ❌ Let operators have Supabase Studio access. Read-only at most.
  • ❌ Edit auth.users or any RLS policy directly without a migration.

Part 7 — Smoke testing

7.1 Daily — 30 seconds (operators do this every morning)

See §0 "30-second daily health check." If any step fails → §10.

7.2 Weekly — 2 minutes (owner does this)

cd ~/Documents/TMMT
SMOKE_BASE_URL=https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app bash scripts/smoke-prod.sh

Expected: Result: 7 passed, 0 failed. Any failure → investigate immediately.

7.3 Per-deployment — 5 minutes (after any code change)

After Vercel auto-deploys a new commit to master:

cd ~/Documents/TMMT
npm run smoke:prod

If it passes, optionally run the full Playwright suite against prod:

npm run test:e2e:prod

7.4 Comprehensive — 5 minutes (run quarterly or after a major release)

Paste this into a terminal — it's the wide smoke that was run when this manual was written:

for url in \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/ \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/login \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/appointment \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/background-check \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/customer-intake \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/handover \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/inspection \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/lead-intake \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/license-upload \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/onboarding-inspection \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/ticket \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/waitlist \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/v/tmmt-rentals \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/partner \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/investor \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/operator \
  https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/executive ; do
    code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 8 "$url")
    echo "$code  $url"
done

Expected codes:

  • 200 for /login and /forms/* (public)
  • 307 for /, /v/..., /partner, /investor, /operator, /executive (auth-required redirect to login)
  • ❌ 404 on anything = broken page

7.5 Local build verification (before pushing code)

cd ~/Documents/TMMT
npm install
npm run check-env   # validates .env without printing secrets
npm run build       # this is the primary CI gate — must pass
npm run lint        # ESLint
npm run test:e2e    # local Playwright suite

If any of these fail locally, do NOT push.

Part 8 — Common admin tasks (one-line recipes)

# Local development
npm run dev                              # start dev server on http://localhost:3000

# Verify the environment
npm run check-env                        # confirms .env + Supabase reachability

# Create a partner-test account (for partner-portal QA)
npm run create-partner-test-user

# Grant admin role to a user
npm run set-admin-role -- user@example.com

# Sync Airtable people into Supabase (one-time per import)
npm run sync:aixmos-people

# Sync this machine's repo with the canonical
npm run sync:machine                     # uses scripts/sync-machine.sh

# Run the production smoke
npm run smoke:prod

Part 9 — Known issues + production action items

As of 2026-05-21, these are confirmed real issues:

KNOWN-1: /forms/customer-intake returns 404 in production

  • Symptom: curl https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/forms/customer-intake → 404
  • Local state: page.tsx exists in master and in the current working branch
  • Diagnosis: the live Vercel deployment is stale — it was built before customer-intake was added (the page was added in commit 61f70c1, master tip is from 2026-05-19 but the deployment is older).
  • Fix: push to master (or trigger a manual Vercel redeploy of master). The owner needs to check the Vercel project's "Production" tab and either click "Redeploy" or push a new commit to master.

KNOWN-2: DEPLOY.md references the wrong URL

  • Symptom: DEPLOY.md says the Vercel project name is tmmt-c919 but https://tmmt-c919.vercel.app/ returns DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND. The actual live URL is https://tmmt-command-center.vercel.app/.
  • Diagnosis: the project was renamed in Vercel (or its URL alias was redirected) but the doc never got updated.
  • Fix: update DEPLOY.md to say tmmt-command-center.vercel.app is the canonical URL.

KNOWN-3: Custom domains not connected

  • https://allinonemanagementsolutions.com → 404
  • https://allinonemanagementsolutions.net → 404
  • Both are intended (per DEPLOY.md env vars NEXT_PUBLIC_PUBLIC_SITE_HOST and NEXT_PUBLIC_OWNER_HUB_HOST) but the DNS isn't pointed at the Vercel app yet.
  • Fix: in Vercel project Settings → Domains, add both domains and follow Vercel's DNS instructions.

KNOWN-4: No in-app password change page

  • Operators can't change their password from inside the app.
  • Workaround: owner resets via Supabase Studio, OR the operator uses Supabase's password-reset email flow (the link is auto-sent).
  • Fix: v1.5 — add a /settings/password page that hits Supabase's updateUser API.

KNOWN-5: Per-role gating is not enforced (only admin matters today)

  • The role landing pages (/operator, /executive, /investor, /vendor, /partner) all exist but a user with admin role can see every venture page regardless of which role landing they "belong to."
  • Fix: v1.5 — per-role RLS + sidebar filtering. Until then, operators with the admin role have full access. The CLAUDE.md and ROADMAP.md track this.

Can't load /login (timeout)Vercel deployment is down OR DNS is brokenCheck https://vercel-status.com. If green, check Vercel project's last build.

Supabase Studio shows no data in a tableThe table is empty OR you're looking at the wrong schema (public vs auth)Confirm schema dropdown at top of the SQL editor.

TMMT / AIXMOS — Company policy (AI review context)

TMMT / AIXMOS — Company policy (AI review context)

Use this document when fact-checking internal commands and operator-facing messages.

Mission

  • Help everyday entrepreneurs access reliable operations infrastructure.
  • TMMT Rentals: professional vehicle rental operations; accurate status, no promises we cannot keep.
  • Standard: premium service — clear, honest, timely communication.

Voice (all operator- and customer-facing relay text)

  • Warm, direct, human — never corporate or scripted.
  • Use the person's first name when known.
  • Short sentences; one clear call to action per message.
  • Never open with company name or price.
  • Never use: "I'm following up", "As per my last", "Circle back", "Hope this finds you well".

Pricing & commitments (do not state unless pre-approved by Muhammad)

  • Do not invent discounts, refunds, or payment terms.
  • Do not promise specific vehicle availability without fleet confirmation.
  • Do not guarantee credit repair outcomes (guidance only).

Roles

  • Owner (admin): final authority; commands to executive VAs.
  • Executive VA: carries out owner commands; may relay approved instructions to operators.
  • Operator: executes field work; sees only published, approved operator messages.

What requires owner approval before external use

  • Investor materials, pricing changes, contract terms.
  • Bulk credential sharing or policy exceptions.
  • Anything marked confidential in admin-only materials.

Operational alignment

  • Commands should be actionable: who, what, when, success criteria.
  • If a message references a customer case, use case number when available.
  • Escalate safety, legal, and insurance issues to owner immediately — do not instruct operators to bypass process.

Fact-check output expectations

  • Flag false or unverifiable claims.
  • Flag tone that violates voice rules.
  • Flag missing clarity (no owner, no deadline, ambiguous audience).
  • Suggest a corrected version when alignment score is below threshold.

Lease-to-Own — Pitch Deck

Lease-to-Own — Pitch Deck

Get the keys today. Own the car at the end. No credit score required.

TMMT's flagship customer-facing program. Front of the AIXMOS funnel.

1. One-line positioning

Income, not credit, gets you behind the wheel — and every payment buys your car.

Variants for ad copy:

  • "Bad credit, no credit, fresh start? If you've got steady income, we've got you driving today."
  • "Stop renting forever. Lease-to-Own with TMMT and own it outright in 36 months."
  • "Drive a Camry or a Charger. Same deal: every payment is yours."

2. Problem

Most working people in this country are locked out of car ownership by two doors:

  • The bank door — needs a 650+ score, two years of credit history, and a clean report. If you've had a rough patch, you're out.
  • The buy-here-pay-here door — high rates, beat-up cars, the dealer holds the title forever, and one missed payment and the car's gone with everything you've put in.

What people actually need: a real car, a real path to ownership, and a lender that judges them by their income — not by something that happened on their credit report three years ago.

3. Solution

TMMT Lease-to-Own. Three tiers. One promise: every payment builds equity in your car, and at the end of the term you own it — title and all — for $1.

  • No credit minimum. Income is what matters.
  • Maintenance and GPS included so the car keeps running and you keep moving.
  • Split-pay option on the down payment — half at signing, half within 30 days — so you can start sooner.
  • Backed by the AIXMOS funnel. If you want to fix your credit and build a business while you're paying off your car, we have a path for that. (Decks 2 and 3.)

4. Who it's for (qualifying criteria)

You qualify for Lease-to-Own if you can show all three:

  1. Verifiable income at the tier floor (see section 7) — paystubs, bank statements, or platform earnings (Uber / Lyft / DoorDash / Instacart all count)
  2. Valid driver's license — state-issued, not expired, not suspended
  3. Proof of address — utility bill, lease, or government mail dated within 60 days

Insurance is required before you drive off, but you can bring your own policy or add the TMMT bundle as an extra line item on your payment.

You do NOT need:

  • A FICO score
  • A cosigner
  • A credit-card history
  • Two years of W-2s
  • Anything from your past credit report

GHL tag at qualification: l2o-qualified

5. How it works

Six steps, start to title:

  1. Apply online at allinonemanagementsolutions.com — 5 minutes, no hard credit pull
  2. Income verification — upload paystubs / bank statements; we confirm within 24 hours
  3. Vehicle selection — pick from the tier you qualified for (Standard / Premium / Elite)
  4. Sign + drive — down payment + first week's payment + insurance proof → keys
  5. Pay on schedule — weekly (Standard) or monthly (Premium / Elite); auto-pay strongly encouraged
  6. Final payment + $1 buyout — title transferred to your name within 14 days, free and clear

GHL stages: Lead → Qualified → Vehicle Selected → Active L2O → Paid Off / Owned

6. What you get

Every TMMT Lease-to-Own customer gets:

  • The car — driven home day one, yours fully at the end of the term
  • Routine maintenance covered — oil changes and tire rotations on a published schedule (no surprise bills)
  • GPS / telematics included — protects both of us, helps with insurance discounts on some carriers
  • Registration and plates — TMMT carries them until ownership transfers (no DMV runs for you mid-term)
  • Membership pathway — first 90 days of on-time payments unlock an invite to the $97/mo AIXMOS membership (Deck 2 territory)

7. Pricing & terms

Three tiers. Pick the one you qualify for.

Tier 1 — Standard

Vehicle band$8,000 – $18,000 used (Camry, Altima, Rogue, Equinox, etc.)
Down payment$3,750 — split-pay option: $1,875 at signing + $1,875 within 30 days
Payment$150 – $250 / week
Term to ownership36 months
Income floor$2,800 / month gross verifiable
End of term$1 buyout → title in your name within 14 days

Tier 2 — Premium

Vehicle band$18,000 – $35,000 (Charger, Mustang, used Tesla Model 3, BMW 3-series, etc.)
Down payment$7,500 — split-pay option available
Payment$600 – $900 / month
Term to ownership48 months
Income floor$4,500 / month gross verifiable
End of term$1 buyout → title in your name within 14 days

Tier 3 — Elite

Vehicle band$35,000+ luxury / performance / luxury EV
Down payment$10,000 – $15,000
Payment[TBD — owner to set monthly band]
Term to ownership48 months
Income floor[TBD — recommend $6,000+ / month]
End of term$1 buyout → title in your name within 14 days

Add-ons (optional)

  • TMMT insurance bundle — added as a separate line item; pricing depends on driver profile and vehicle
  • Early payoff — no penalty; pay off any time and the title transfers

What's included in every tier

Maintenance (oil, tires), GPS, registration/plates in TMMT's name until transfer.

What's not included

Fuel, parking, tolls, tickets, customer-caused damage outside of normal wear.

8. The TMMT × AIXMOS advantage

Why this works for us and not the corner buy-here-pay-here lot:

  • We're not in the repo business. Buy-here-pay-here lots make money on default and resale. We make money on customers who finish — because finishers become $97 AIXMOS members, credit-guidance clients, and business-funding handoffs. Our incentives are aligned with the customer's.
  • We run a real fleet operation. The same software that tracks our rental fleet (TMMT OS, 44 tables, 1,453+ records) tracks L2O contracts, payments, and maintenance. We don't lose paperwork.
  • We're connected to a credit and capital ecosystem. The customer who finishes their L2O can roll directly into credit guidance and then into business funding — paths they can't access at a used-car lot.
  • We pre-qualify on income, not feelings. The bar is published, the documents are public — no salesperson "working out a deal." Same offer for everyone in the same tier.

9. Where it leads (cross-sell into the next deck)

The L2O contract is the front of a funnel. Sequence:

  1. Day 0 — customer signs L2O, gets tagged l2o-active
  2. Day 60–90 — on-time payment history triggers invite to $97/mo AIXMOS membership; tag becomes ready-for-aixmos
  3. Day 120+ — paying member with intake complete → Deck 2 — Credit Guidance pitch
  4. Post-guidance — owner tags funding-prep → Deck 3 — Business Funding handoff

This sequence is the AIXMOS-TMMT funnel — do not skip steps. See docs/AIXMOS-TMMT-FUNNEL.md.

10. Top 5 objections + compliant answers

"Is this a scam? Drive home today with no credit check?"

Not a scam — and that's exactly why we publish every term in writing. You're signing a lease-purchase agreement, the car is in TMMT's name until your final payment, and the law in your state regulates how that works. Read the contract. Ask any question. We're a real business with a fleet, an office, and a software stack.

"What if I miss a payment?"

We have a published grace period and a late fee schedule. We work with people who communicate. If you stop communicating and stop paying, the vehicle gets recovered — that's the same as any auto loan. The difference is we don't try to trap you; we'd rather have a paying customer than a recovered car.

"What's the actual total I'll pay?"

Down payment + (weekly or monthly payment × term) + $1 buyout + your insurance choice. Run the math up front; we'll do it with you. No balloon at the end, no surprise fees.

"My credit's terrible — does that change my rate?"

Your credit doesn't change anything here. The tier you qualify for is set by your income, not your FICO. That's the whole point.

"Can I pay it off early?"

Yes. No prepayment penalty. Pay it off whenever, title transfers within 14 days.

11. Audience-specific framing

For a customer (DM / landing page / ad)

Tired of waiting for your credit to be "good enough" to drive what you actually need? TMMT Lease-to-Own gets you behind the wheel with proof of income and a license — no credit check, no cosigner. Every payment builds toward owning it outright. Standard tier starts at $3,750 down (split that in half if you need to), $150–$250 a week, 36 months to title. Apply in 5 minutes.

For a sales rep / operator

Lead with the income-only qualification — it's the wedge. Surface the split-pay down payment when you hit price resistance. Maintenance + GPS included is your differentiator vs. buy-here-pay-here lots. The $1 buyout at the end is the close: "every payment is yours." Tag the lead in GHL the moment they upload proof of income (l2o-qualified). Do not promise vehicles you can't deliver — pull from real fleet inventory.

For a referral partner (other dealer / broker / community influencer)

TMMT funds the credit-impaired customers your finance department turns away. We pay a referral on funded deals (terms documented in GHL opportunity notes per docs/sops/FUNDING-HANDOFF-SOP.md). Send us a lead with proof of income and we'll get back to you within 24 hours with a tier qualification. Our customers also feed into our AIXMOS membership and credit guidance — so you're not just sending us a one-shot referral, you're sending us a multi-touch customer.

For an investor / capital partner

Lease-to-Own is the acquisition channel for a three-step monetization funnel: vehicle → membership → credit guidance → funding handoff. Vehicle revenue is recurring (weekly/monthly), backed by GPS-tracked collateral, with income-based underwriting that hits a market the prime auto lenders ignore. Default risk is mitigated by (a) GPS recovery, (b) maintenance inclusion reducing breakdown-induced default, and (c) downstream AIXMOS membership giving us leverage to keep customers paying. See docs/PARTNER-PORTAL.md for read-only fleet visibility.

12. Call to action — exact next step

Customer-facing CTA:

Apply at allinonemanagementsolutions.com — 5 minutes, no hard credit pull. We'll text you within 24 hours.

GHL tag to apply at lead capture: l2o-lead GHL tag at qualification: l2o-qualified GHL tag at signing: l2o-active GHL tag at final payment: l2o-paid-off

Operator action on a positive intake:

  1. Log call in GHL within 30 minutes
  2. Apply l2o-qualified tag once income docs verified
  3. Route to vehicle-selection workflow

13. Compliance footer (deck-specific)

  • Never promise a specific vehicle that isn't in current TMMT fleet inventory
  • Never verbally adjust the published down payment, payment, or term without owner sign-off — GHL opportunity note required
  • Never describe this as "financing" in a way that implies a bank loan — it's a lease-purchase
  • Never quote insurance prices — insurance is a separate line item and depends on the customer's driver profile and carrier
  • Always read the customer the term length and total payment count before they sign
  • Always document the down-payment plan (single vs. split-pay) in the contract

State regulations on lease-purchase / rent-to-own vehicles vary. Owner approval is required before pitching this program in any new state not already in TMMT's active service area.

See also: README.md for the universal compliance footer that applies to every deck.

Credit Guidance — Pitch Deck

Credit Guidance — Pitch Deck

A guided path to a stronger credit profile. No score guarantees. No magic. Just the work, done with someone who's been there.

The middle of the AIXMOS funnel. Members only.

⚠️ Language rule — read first

This program is credit guidance. It is never credit repair.

The team internally knows this as "the credit repair deck," but the word repair never appears in:

  • Ad creative
  • Landing pages
  • DMs, comments, or replies
  • Sales calls
  • SOPs (it doesn't, and we keep it that way)

Why: "credit repair" is a regulated category under the federal Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA) and state-equivalent laws. Companies that advertise as credit repair organizations have strict disclosure, contract, and refund obligations — and "I'll fix your credit" promises are an enforcement trigger. Guidance describes what we actually do: we educate, we route to approved vendors, we coach on dispute and rebuilding fundamentals. We don't promise outcomes.

If a customer says "so you're a credit repair company?", the right answer is:

"We're a credit guidance program. We educate, coach, and connect you to vetted partners. We don't promise specific score outcomes — anyone who does is selling you something we wouldn't."

1. One-line positioning

You don't need a miracle. You need a plan, a guide, and someone in your corner.

Variants for ad copy:

  • "Stop guessing at your credit. Get a real plan, from people who've done it."
  • "Tired of YouTube credit hacks that go nowhere? Try guidance from someone who's worked with hundreds of profiles."
  • "Your credit profile is fixable. We don't promise scores — we promise honest work."

2. Problem

The credit-fix space is full of three kinds of operators, none of them good:

  • The "guaranteed 100 points in 30 days" scammer — illegal, FTC bait, takes your money and disappears
  • The DIY YouTube rabbit hole — overwhelming, contradictory, and you end up doing nothing
  • The slow attorney route — works, but costs $3k+ and feels like climbing a mountain alone

What people need: a guided plan, real coaching, vetted partner work where it's actually needed, and someone who'll tell them the truth about what's possible and what isn't.

3. Solution

AIXMOS Credit Guidance. A $500–$1,000 program built around three things:

  1. A real consult — 30 minutes with a guide who reviews your goals, your timeline, and what documents you need
  2. A packaged plan — concrete next steps, tier-priced so you know exactly what you're paying for
  3. Vendor-routed execution where warranted — disputes, validations, and bureau interactions are handled by approved partners with real track records, not by us guessing

What you'll never hear from us:

  • "Guaranteed X points"
  • "Deletions in 30 days"
  • "We've got bureau insiders"

What you will hear:

  • "Here's what your profile looks like, here's what's actually movable, here's the realistic timeline."

4. Who it's for (qualifying criteria)

This program is AIXMOS members only. Specifically:

  1. Active member-97 tag in GHL — you're a paying $97/month member
  2. Completed AIXMOS intake form at /apply (or via GHL)
  3. Owner or executive VA approval for any high-ticket package

Hard exclusions (we'll wait you out on these):

  • ❌ Active rental dispute with TMMT
  • ❌ Open collections case against you that involves us
  • ❌ Bankruptcy filed in the last 30 days — we'll talk in 60

GHL stage at entry: Member $97 → Credit Consult Booked

5. How it works

Six steps, anchored in docs/sops/CREDIT-GUIDANCE-SOP.md:

  1. Consult (30 minutes) — review your goals, timeline, and which documents you'll need
  2. Package selection — tier chosen based on profile complexity ($500–$1,000 band)
  3. Payment — GHL invoice or checkout; we tag you credit-guidance-active
  4. Vendor routing — assign you to the right approved partner for your situation
  5. Weekly check-in — your operator or VA logs progress in GHL; you always know where you stand
  6. Completion handoff — deliverable checklist signed; if funding is your next step, you're tagged funding-prep and Deck 3 begins

GHL stages: Credit Consult Booked → Credit Guidance Active → Funding Prep (if applicable)

6. What you get

  • 30-minute consult with a guide who reviews your full profile
  • A written plan with milestones, expected timeline range, and what the work involves
  • Vendor work routed to approved partners (disputes, validations, etc.) — handled professionally
  • Weekly progress check-ins logged in GHL so you can verify what's been done
  • A completion package at the end documenting what changed (and what didn't) and what to do next
  • A clear path to business funding if your profile improves enough to qualify (Deck 3)

What you don't get (because no honest program offers it):

  • A guaranteed score outcome
  • A guaranteed deletion of any specific tradeline
  • A guaranteed timeline to a specific number

7. Pricing & terms

Program band$500 – $1,000
Tier basisProfile complexity and scope of work (more tradelines / collections = higher tier)
Tier set byYour guide during the consult, with owner approval on high-ticket placement
PaymentGHL invoice or checkout; paid in full before vendor routing
Refund policyOwner-approved exceptions only — see SOP
Membership prerequisite$97 / month AIXMOS membership (active throughout the program)

No upfront fees outside the published price. No off-menu discounts without owner sign-off.

8. The TMMT × AIXMOS advantage

Why this works where YouTube and standalone credit-repair shops don't:

  • You're already in our system. If you came through TMMT Lease-to-Own, we already see your payment discipline — and a positive auto trade is one of the most powerful credit-rebuilding tools that exists. Your TMMT history is itself part of the work.
  • We earn the right to upsell. You don't get pitched credit guidance until you've been a paying member ($97) for long enough to know we deliver value. That filters out tire-kickers and aligns incentives.
  • Vendor accountability. Our approved-partner list isn't who paid for placement — it's who's produced results for our members. We rotate vendors out who underperform.
  • A real downstream path. Most credit programs end when the program ends. Ours ends with a warm handoff into business funding for members who've earned the eligibility (Deck 3).

9. Where it leads (cross-sell into the next deck)

Credit guidance is rarely the destination — it's the bridge.

  1. Day 0 — credit-guidance-active tag applied, vendor routing begins
  2. Weekly — check-ins logged in GHL
  3. Completion — deliverable checklist signed
  4. Owner trigger — if profile + cash-flow story support it, owner tags funding-prep
  5. Handoff — Deck 3 — Business Funding begins

Not every member is a funding candidate. The honest conversation matters more than the upsell.

10. Top 5 objections + compliant answers

"How many points will my score go up?"

We don't quote score outcomes. Anyone who does is either lying or about to get a CFPB letter. What we will do is walk you through your profile, tell you what's realistically movable, and show you the work as it happens.

"How long until I can apply for funding?"

Depends on your starting profile and the scope of the work. The guidance program itself is structured around a checklist — when the checklist is done, we evaluate funding readiness honestly. Some members are there in 60 days, some in 6+ months, some never qualify and we tell them that straight.

"Why does this cost $500–$1,000?"

Because we use real vendors for the bureau-facing work, your guide spends real time on your case, and we cap our member count per operator so no one becomes a number. There's a YouTube version of all of this — it costs you your time and a lot of guesswork.

"Can't I just do this myself?"

Yes. We tell members that on the consult. If you have the time, the patience, and the stomach for bureau response cycles, you absolutely can. We're for people who want a guided path with someone who's done it many times.

"What happens if it doesn't work?"

We define "work" up front in the written plan — concrete deliverables, not a score promise. If we don't deliver what's in the plan, that's a refund conversation under our owner-approval refund policy. If your score doesn't move as much as you hoped despite us delivering, that's the reality of credit work, and we'll have told you up front.

11. Audience-specific framing

For a customer (DM / landing page / ad — members only)

Your $97 membership unlocks our Credit Guidance program — a real plan, with a real guide, routed through real partners. No score promises. No "credit repair" gimmicks. $500–$1,000 depending on what your profile actually needs. Book your 30-minute consult to find out which tier fits.

For a sales rep / operator

Never quote a score. Never promise a deletion. Your job in the consult is diagnostic: understand the member's goals, map them to one of the tiers, and set realistic expectations. The members who finish this program are the ones who become funding candidates — so a careful consult is worth more than a fast close. Log everything in GHL within 30 minutes of the call.

For a referral partner

If you work with credit-impaired clients (auto, mortgage broker, financial coach, small business advisor), our Credit Guidance program is what to send them when you can't help yet. We don't compete with you — when they're funding-ready, we route them back to you or to our approved capital partners depending on the deal type. Referral terms documented in GHL opportunity notes.

For an investor / capital partner

Credit Guidance is the unit-economics multiplier in the AIXMOS funnel. A $97/month member who books guidance ($500–$1k) and completes funding handoff (revenue-share with partner) has lifetime value well above the L2O acquisition cost. The membership prerequisite enforces stickiness; the vendor-rotation policy controls quality risk. See SOP at docs/sops/CREDIT-GUIDANCE-SOP.md.

12. Call to action — exact next step

Member-facing CTA:

Book your 30-minute Credit Guidance consult through your member portal or text us. We'll talk you through what's possible, what isn't, and which tier fits your profile.

GHL flow:

  1. Member books consult → stage Credit Consult Booked
  2. Consult completed → guide notes tier recommendation in GHL
  3. Owner / exec VA approves high-ticket placement
  4. Invoice paid → tag credit-guidance-active, stage Credit Guidance Active
  5. Vendor routing
  6. Weekly check-ins logged in GHL within 30 minutes of each touch
  7. Completion checklist → stage Funding Prep if applicable

13. Compliance footer (deck-specific)

This is the most regulation-sensitive deck. Read it twice.

Never say:

  • ❌ "Credit repair" — in any context, in any channel, to anyone, ever
  • ❌ "Guaranteed score increase of X points"
  • ❌ "Guaranteed deletion of [tradeline / collection / late payment]"
  • ❌ "We have a bureau contact" / "We know someone at [Equifax / Experian / TransUnion]"
  • ❌ "Risk-free" / "No risk" / "100% effective"
  • ❌ Specific timelines to a specific score ("700 in 90 days")

Always:

  • ✅ Use the word guidance — in copy, on calls, in comments
  • ✅ Set expectations in writing during the consult
  • ✅ Document tier placement and pricing rationale in GHL
  • ✅ Route bureau-facing work to approved vendors only
  • ✅ Owner approval on any refund or payment-plan exception

Required at sign-up:

  • Member must already hold an active $97/month AIXMOS membership
  • Written plan must be delivered before vendor routing
  • Refund policy reference must appear in the invoice

Regulatory context: the federal Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA) and several state analogs regulate organizations that advertise credit-improvement services. Operating as a guidance program with a member-prerequisite and explicit no-guarantee positioning is intentional and protective. Do not freelance language that could be construed as a credit-repair claim — even in a TikTok comment, even in a DM, even off-camera.

Business Funding — Pitch Deck

Business Funding — Pitch Deck

The capital handoff at the end of the funnel. You've earned it the right way — now we make the introduction.

End of the AIXMOS funnel. Owner-gated. Partner-routed.

1. One-line positioning

A warm introduction to real capital — backed by proof of operations, not promises.

Variants for ad copy / member messaging:

  • "You've built a credit profile, you've shown payment discipline, you've got an entity. Now let's get you funded."
  • "Don't shop yourself around to ten lenders. We hand you off to one that fits — with a story already built."
  • "Business funding isn't about luck. It's about the package. We build the package, you keep the capital."

2. Problem

Most small-business owners apply for funding the wrong way:

  • They walk into a bank cold with no story, no documentation discipline, and a credit profile that's not yet been positioned for a business application
  • They get bounced around predatory MCA brokers who shop their data to ten desks at once, tank their underwriting, and skim 15% off the top
  • They get turned down, then get desperate, then take a stacked-position cash advance that strangles cash flow within 90 days

The thing those three paths have in common: no operating story. The applicant shows up as a stranger.

3. Solution

AIXMOS Business Funding Handoff. We don't fund you ourselves. We do something better:

  • We build the package. Bank statements, ID, entity docs, credit guidance summary, TMMT rental history (if applicable) — assembled before any lender sees you.
  • We make the warm introduction. One partner at a time, hand-picked for fit, with the package and the story already in their inbox.
  • We share the rev. When a deal funds, the partner pays a documented share, and the operator/AIXMOS split is documented in GHL before any external commit.

You walk into the partner conversation already vetted, already documented, and already credentialed by us. That's worth a lot more than another cold application.

4. Who it's for (qualifying criteria)

This program is gated. We pitch it when (and only when):

  1. credit-guidance-active tag in GHL — or completed guidance checklist
  2. Owner has tagged you funding-prep — this is a deliberate, manual decision, not an automatic graduation
  3. You have an entity — LLC (or corp); if not, AIXMOS can help you form one before we route
  4. You have a verifiable revenue or cash-flow story — paystubs alone are not a business funding story; we need business bank statements, TMMT rental history, or platform earnings showing operational discipline

GHL stage at entry: Funding Prep

What disqualifies you (at least temporarily):

  • ❌ No business entity yet (we'll help you form one first)
  • ❌ Active collections case
  • ❌ Bankruptcy in the last 12 months
  • ❌ Refusal to share basic documentation
  • ❌ Owner judgment that the profile or story isn't ready

5. How it works

Anchored in docs/sops/FUNDING-HANDOFF-SOP.md:

  1. Handoff package assembly — we collect the documents listed in section 6 below
  2. Profile narrative — a one-page story we write describing your operational discipline (TMMT rental history is gold here — it shows you make payments, run a fleet, manage customers)
  3. Partner selection — owner picks the funding partner from the approved vendor list based on your profile fit
  4. Warm intro email — CHUMMO-voice intro from us to the partner, single CTA to book your partner call
  5. Partner call — you and the lender / broker, with our package already in their hands
  6. Stage progression — GHL stage moves to Funding Prep → Funded / Closed Won when the partner confirms

We do not chase. One partner, one fit. If the first fit doesn't work, we re-evaluate, we don't shotgun.

6. What you get

Handoff package contents

DocumentWhy it's in the package
Last 3 months business bank statementsProves real cash flow — the #1 thing any funder will ask for
ID + proof of addressStandard KYC requirement
Credit guidance summaryShows your profile was actively worked, not just hoping. Raw bureau data is never emailed.
Business entity docsLLC formation, EIN, operating agreement
TMMT rental history (if applicable)Proof-of-operations narrative — you ran a fleet, made payments, kept insurance current

What you also get

  • Single-partner warm intro instead of being shopped to ten desks (which itself is a credit-damaging move)
  • Pre-positioned narrative that frames you as a real operator, not a stranger
  • Documented rev-share so you know exactly what AIXMOS earns on the deal (no hidden margin)
  • Owner approval gate — no rogue intros, no surprises

7. Pricing & terms

There is no upfront fee for the handoff itself, outside the credit guidance program that gates it. AIXMOS earns on the back end via a partner rev-share documented per deal in GHL.

Member fee for handoff$0 (built into the AIXMOS funnel — the $97 membership + credit guidance are the gate)
AIXMOS revenuePartner rev-share, documented per deal in GHL opportunity notes
Operator splitDocumented in GHL; owner approves before external commit
PrerequisiteActive or completed credit guidance + funding-prep tag

Off-menu fees are not allowed. Any departure from this structure requires owner sign-off, in writing, in GHL.

8. The TMMT × AIXMOS advantage

What we bring that a cold broker doesn't:

  • A funnel-built customer. By the time we hand you off, you've already shown payment discipline through TMMT Lease-to-Own, paid $97/month for AIXMOS membership, and completed Credit Guidance. Funders love that story.
  • A documentation discipline. Our customers don't show up with a shoebox and a vibe. They show up with an organized package because we organize it for them.
  • A single-partner intro instead of a stacked submission. Stacking applications is a credit-killer and a partner-relationship-killer. We don't do it.
  • A real operating data source. TMMT OS tracks the rental history. AIXMOS Command Center tracks the membership and guidance. The handoff is built from data, not memory.
  • A long-term relationship with our funding partners. They take our intros because the close rate is high and the documents are clean. We protect that by being selective on who we send.

9. Where it leads

This is the funnel's terminal step on the AIXMOS side. After funding, two paths:

  • Reinvest in vehicles — funded operators often expand their TMMT fleet (you've been a customer, now you can be a fleet contributor / partner)
  • Operator path — graduates of the funnel sometimes become AIXMOS operators themselves, supporting the next wave of members (docs/sops/OPERATOR-NETWORK-SOP.md)

Neither is automatic. Both require a separate conversation.

10. Top 5 objections + compliant answers

"How much can I get funded for?"

We don't quote approval amounts. That's the funder's call based on your real package. We've seen a wide range — what matters is the package we hand them is clean, and the right partner is matched to your profile.

"What rate will I get?"

Same answer — that's the partner's decision based on your profile. We won't quote rates, and any broker who does pre-application is making it up. What we control is the quality of the introduction.

"Why don't you fund me directly?"

Because we'd be a worse funder for you than our partners. They have warehouse lines, regulatory licenses, and risk infrastructure we don't. Our edge is in qualifying and presenting members, not in carrying the credit risk ourselves.

"What's AIXMOS's cut?"

Documented in GHL on every deal — you can see it. Partner pays the rev-share, not you. We don't take fees from the funded amount.

"What if the first partner says no?"

Then we reassess together. Sometimes that means more time in credit guidance, sometimes it means a different partner, sometimes it means a different funding product. We don't burn through partner relationships shotgunning applications.

11. Audience-specific framing

For a member (DM / portal / call)

You've done the work — payments are clean, your guidance program is closing out, your entity is set up. Now it's time for the introduction. Owner will tag you funding-prep when we believe your package is ready, and we'll route you to the funding partner that fits your profile. No shotgun applications. No upfront fees. One warm intro.

For a sales rep / operator

Never promise an approval amount. Never promise a rate. Your job in this handoff is documentation and narrative, not lending. The handoff package list in docs/sops/FUNDING-HANDOFF-SOP.md is your checklist — don't deviate. If the member is missing a document, get the document before the intro, not during.

For a referral / capital partner (the lender on the other side)

Members we route to you have come through a vetted pipeline: TMMT payment history, $97/month membership, AIXMOS Credit Guidance completion. They arrive with a packaged file — three months of statements, entity docs, guidance summary, KYC. They are not stacked submissions. Rev-share is documented per deal, in GHL, before we make the intro. We protect the relationship by being selective and clean.

For an investor

The funding handoff is the last step in a four-stage funnel that compounds customer lifetime value: vehicle (TMMT) → membership ($97 recurring) → guidance ($500–$1k one-time) → funding (rev-share). The handoff is the highest-margin step on the AIXMOS side and is also the strongest moat — it's built on partner relationships that take years to develop. Deal volume is gated by owner approval, intentionally, to preserve close rate and partner trust.

12. Call to action — exact next step

Member-facing CTA (when owner tags funding-prep):

Your funding prep file is being assembled. We'll text you a short list of documents to upload to your portal. Once those are in, we'll write your profile narrative and introduce you to the partner we believe fits your profile best. Watch your inbox.

GHL flow:

  1. Member completes credit guidance → owner reviews readiness
  2. Owner applies funding-prep tag → stage Funding Prep
  3. Operator collects handoff package (see SOP checklist)
  4. Owner writes profile narrative + selects partner
  5. Warm intro email sent → CTA: book partner call
  6. Partner call held
  7. Funding confirmed → stage Funded / Closed Won, rev-share recorded in GHL

13. Compliance footer (deck-specific)

Never:

  • ❌ Quote a guaranteed funding amount
  • ❌ Quote a guaranteed rate, APR, or term
  • ❌ Promise approval — that's the partner's decision
  • ❌ Collect raw credit bureau data via email (use the portal / encrypted vendor channel only)
  • ❌ Charge an upfront fee outside the AIXMOS published pricing without owner sign-off
  • ❌ Send the member to more than one funder at a time (no stacked submissions)
  • ❌ Modify the rev-share without documenting it in GHL before commit

Always:

  • ✅ Document the rev-share in GHL opportunity notes before any external commit
  • ✅ Owner approves partner selection
  • ✅ Use the TMMT rental history (when applicable) as a proof-of-operations story, not as collateral, unless the partner specifically requests it
  • ✅ Confirm the partner's terms are received by the member in writing before they sign

State and federal regulations on broker arrangements, commercial lending, and merchant cash advances vary significantly. Our role is referrer, not lender, not broker-of-record. The partner is the regulated party. We protect that boundary by never quoting terms and by documenting our rev-share as a marketing/referral arrangement per partner agreement.

What we never say

2. Customer-facing pitch (long form)

Drop-in for DMs, landing pages, IG/Facebook ad bodies, long-form captions.

Tired of waiting for your credit to be "good enough" to drive what you actually need? TMMT Lease-to-Own gets you behind the wheel with proof of income and a license — no credit check, no cosigner. Every payment builds toward owning it outright. Standard tier starts at $3,750 down (split that in half if you need to), $150–$250 a week, 36 months to title. Apply in 5 minutes.

3. Hooks bank — short-form openers

10+ tested-style hooks for 3–15s short-form. Mix and match. Label tone for A/B testing.

Identity hooks

  • "POV: you just got declined by another bank and they told you to 'work on your credit.'"

(strong empathy open — pair with B-roll of the customer driving away in a car they bought through us)

(broad relatable identity — works across all three programs, lead with it for L2O)

  • "I drive a [Charger / Tesla / Camry] and never showed anyone my FICO. Here's how."

(POV / on-camera — customer or operator testimonial format)

(niche-down identity — repeat for DoorDash, Lyft, Instacart, gig workers in general)

Curiosity hooks

  • "Three things you need to drive home today. None of them is your credit score."

(payoff: license, income proof, proof of address — fast list, end on CTA)

  • "What buy-here-pay-here lots don't tell you about who actually keeps the car."

(payoff: we don't profit on default; our incentives are aligned with customers who finish)

  • "There's a half-down option most dealers won't offer. Here's how it works."

(payoff: split $3,750 into $1,875 + $1,875 within 30 days)

Contrarian hooks

  • "Bad credit + a paystub beats good credit + a story. Watch this."

(reframe the underwriting conversation in 7 seconds)

  • "Everyone tells you to 'wait until your credit is better.' We tell you to bring your paystub."

(direct anti-status-quo, strong on TikTok)

Proof / concrete hooks

  • "$3,750 down. $200 a week. 36 months. Title in your hands."

(let the numbers do the work — text-overlay-only video, 6 seconds, zero VO needed)

  • "Drive home today in a [vehicle]. Every payment is yours."

(pair with vehicle-walk-around B-roll)

Urgency hooks

  • "Tired of 'no'? Show us a paystub instead."

(direct call-to-action open — works as captioned static for Snap/IG Story)

  • "Stop scrolling if your credit is the only thing keeping you from a car."

(stop-scroll pattern interrupt — known TikTok performer style)

4. Comment & DM reply stock

Pre-approved replies to the most common comments. Use these. Don't free-write.

"Is this a scam?"

Real business — we run a fleet, have an office, and publish every term in writing. The agreement is a lease-purchase that's regulated in your state. DM us, we'll send you the term sheet to read before any conversation.

"What credit score do I need?"

No credit minimum on this program. Income is what qualifies you ($2,800/mo gross for Standard tier). Paystubs, bank statements, or platform earnings all count.

"How much down?"

Standard tier is $3,750 down. We offer a split-pay option so you can put $1,875 at signing and $1,875 within 30 days if you need to spread it.

"What if I miss a payment?"

Published grace period and late fee schedule — we work with people who communicate. Stop communicating, stop paying, the car gets recovered, same as any auto loan. Difference is we want you to finish.

"Can I pay it off early?"

Yes. Zero prepayment penalty. Title transfers within 14 days of your final payment.

"What states are you in?"

DM us your state and we'll confirm — we're not yet in every state and we won't pitch the program in one where we're not approved to operate.

"Where's the catch?"

No catch — but here's what some people consider one: TMMT holds the title until your final payment, and we require GPS on the vehicle during the term. Both standard for lease-purchase, both there to protect the program for everyone in it.

5. Compliance reminder (creative-specific)

Read before scheduling any post.

  • ❌ Never name a specific vehicle in an ad unless it's actually in current TMMT inventory
  • ❌ Never quote an insurance price (insurance is a separate add-on; pricing varies per driver)
  • ❌ Never call the program "financing" or "a loan" — it's a lease-purchase
  • ❌ Never imply "no risk" — the customer assumes payment obligations; we say so in plain English
  • ❌ Never promise approval — "you qualify if you can show X, Y, Z" is fine; "you're approved" is not
  • ✅ Always show the down payment, weekly/monthly payment, and term length together — never one of the three alone
  • ✅ Always end with the CTA from the deck's section 12: apply at allinonemanagementsolutions.com

State regulations on lease-purchase / rent-to-own vehicles vary. Owner approval required before geotargeting a new state.

Credit Guidance — Social Creatives Source

Credit Guidance — Social Creatives Source

Working source for TikTok / Reels / Snap / IG / Meta creative on the AIXMOS Credit Guidance program.

Pulled from ../02-credit-guidance.md. When the deck updates, this file gets re-synced.

⚠️ Read this first

The word "credit repair" never appears in any creative. Not in captions, not in voiceover, not in comments, not in DMs. The program is credit guidance. Why this is non-negotiable: federal CROA + state-equivalent regs make "credit repair" a regulated advertising category. Stay clean.

The hooks below are intentionally anti-promise — they win attention by calling out scammy claims and positioning us as the honest alternative. That's the wedge.

1. One-liners (positioning variants)

Drop-in lines for captions, bios, ad headlines, end-card text.

  • You don't need a miracle. You need a plan, a guide, and someone in your corner.
  • Stop guessing at your credit. Get a real plan, from people who've done it.
  • Tired of YouTube credit hacks that go nowhere? Try guidance from someone who's worked with hundreds of profiles.
  • Your credit profile is fixable. We don't promise scores — we promise honest work.
  • We don't quote score outcomes. We quote what we'll actually do.
  • The credit conversation, without the gimmicks.

2. Customer-facing pitch (long form)

Drop-in for member DMs, member-only landing pages, in-portal banners.

Your $97 membership unlocks our Credit Guidance program — a real plan, with a real guide, routed through real partners. No score promises. No "credit repair" gimmicks. $500–$1,000 depending on what your profile actually needs. Book your 30-minute consult to find out which tier fits.

Shorter variant (in-portal nudge):

Member exclusive: book your 30-min Credit Guidance consult. Real plan, real partners, no score promises.

Medium variant (member email / SMS):

Ready to work on your credit profile with a real guide instead of YouTube guessing? Book a 30-min consult — we'll tell you what's possible, what isn't, and which tier fits. Members only.

3. Hooks bank — short-form openers

12 hooks that get attention by being honest rather than flashy. The credit space is so full of scams that authentic voice is a differentiator.

Authority / contrarian hooks (strongest in this category)

  • "If anyone promises you 100 points in 30 days, run."

(strongest anti-scam open — the audience is exhausted by these promises; we win by naming them)

  • "I'm not going to fix your credit. Here's what we'll actually do."

(direct contrarian — pair with on-camera operator explaining the consult process)

  • "Why I refuse to quote a score outcome — and why every honest program does the same."

(authority + compliance education in one hook)

  • "The honest version of what credit programs do."

(payoff: we educate, we route to vetted vendors, we coach — no magic)

  • "Watch this before you pay anyone to 'fix' your credit."

(warning open — strong stop-scroll on TikTok)

Identity hooks

  • "POV: you've spent 6 months on credit YouTube and your score hasn't moved."

(empathy for the DIY rabbit-hole audience — that's the exact target)

  • "If you've been scammed by a 'credit repair' company before, this video is for you."

(strong identity, painful resonance, instantly positions us as the alternative)

Curiosity hooks

  • "Why DIY credit hacks work for some people and not others."

(payoff: profile complexity — not every issue is a dispute issue, which is why guidance matters)

  • "Three things real credit guidance does that no YouTube video can do for you."

(payoff: vetted-vendor routing, personalized plan, weekly check-ins)

  • "The reason most credit work fails has nothing to do with the bureaus."

(payoff: most people don't follow through — the weekly check-in is the differentiator)

Reframe hooks

  • "Credit isn't broken. Most people's plan is."

(reframe the conversation from "fix" to "plan" — supports the guidance language)

  • "Stop guessing at your credit. Start with a real plan."

(direct imperative, simple call-to-action)

4. Comment & DM reply stock

Use these. Free-writing replies is the #1 way reps get the company in trouble in this category.

"So you're a credit repair company?"

We're a credit guidance program — different category, different rules. We educate, coach, and connect members to vetted partners. We don't promise specific score outcomes. Anyone who does is selling you something we wouldn't.

"How many points will my score go up?"

We don't quote score outcomes. Anyone who does is either lying or about to get a CFPB letter. What we will do is walk you through your profile during the consult, tell you what's realistically movable, and show you the work as it happens.

"How long does it take?"

Depends on your starting profile and scope of work. The guidance program itself runs to a checklist — when the checklist is done, we evaluate together. Some members get to where they want in 60 days, some 6+ months, some never qualify for the next step and we tell them that straight.

"How much does it cost?"

$500–$1,000 depending on which tier fits your profile. The tier is set during the consult, with owner approval on higher-tier placement. You have to be an active AIXMOS member ($97/mo) to access the program.

"Why does it cost that much?"

Because we use real vendors for bureau-facing work, your guide spends real time on your case, and we cap how many members each operator carries so nobody becomes a number. The YouTube version exists — it costs your time and a lot of guessing.

"Can I just do this myself?"

Yes. We tell members that on the consult. If you have the time, patience, and stomach for bureau response cycles, you can absolutely do it solo. We're for people who want a guided path with someone who's done it many times.

"What if it doesn't work?"

"Work" gets defined up front in the written plan — concrete deliverables, not a score promise. If we don't deliver what's in the plan, that's a refund conversation under our owner-approval refund policy. If your score doesn't move as much as you hoped despite us delivering, that's the reality of credit work, and we'll have told you up front.

"Why is this members only?"

Because the program works best when there's a relationship in place. The $97/month membership is how you qualify for guidance — it filters out tire-kickers and means we know who we're working with.

5. Compliance reminder (creative-specific)

This is the most regulation-sensitive program we run. Read it again.

Never in any creative:

  • ❌ The phrase "credit repair" — anywhere, in any caption, in any comment
  • ❌ "Guaranteed score increase," "guaranteed deletion," "X points in Y days"
  • ❌ "We have a bureau contact" / "we know someone inside"
  • ❌ "Risk-free" / "100% effective" / "you can't lose"
  • ❌ Before-and-after screenshots of credit scores
  • ❌ Naming specific tradelines or accounts in customer-facing creative

Always:

  • ✅ The word guidance — every time, in every form
  • ✅ State the membership prerequisite ($97/month AIXMOS membership)
  • ✅ State the pricing band ($500–$1,000) honestly
  • ✅ Lead with anti-promise positioning — that's our differentiator

Anti-pattern to watch for in creator/UGC content: A creator says on-camera, "they raised my score by X points." If we paid for or boosted that content, that's a problem. Don't run UGC ads that quote score outcomes — even from real customers — without legal review. The cleanest UGC content is process-focused ("here's what the consult was like"), not outcome-focused ("I went from X to Y").

Reg context: federal CROA + state analogs regulate credit-improvement advertising. Our positioning as a member-gated guidance program is structurally protective — don't blow it with a sloppy caption.

Full deck: ../02-credit-guidance.md. Universal compliance: ../README.md#universal-compliance-footer. Underlying SOP: ../../sops/CREDIT-GUIDANCE-SOP.md.

Business Funding — Social Creatives Source

Business Funding — Social Creatives Source

Working source for TikTok / Reels / Snap / IG / Meta creative on the AIXMOS Business Funding handoff.

Pulled from ../03-business-funding.md. When the deck updates, this file gets re-synced.

⚠️ Read this first

This program is the most position-sensitive of the three. We are a referrer, not a lender, not a broker-of-record. Every creative should reflect that — we don't quote amounts, we don't quote rates, we don't promise approval. What we sell is the quality of the introduction.

Strongest creative angles for this category:

  • Anti-stacking ("stop applying to ten lenders at once")
  • Process ("here's the package they actually want to see")
  • Proof-of-system (how our funnel produces clean files)

1. One-liners (positioning variants)

Drop-in lines for captions, bios, ad headlines, end-card text.

  • A warm introduction to real capital — backed by proof of operations, not promises.
  • You've built a credit profile, you've shown payment discipline, you've got an entity. Now let's get you funded.
  • Don't shop yourself around to ten lenders. We hand you off to one that fits — with a story already built.
  • Business funding isn't about luck. It's about the package. We build the package, you keep the capital.
  • We don't fund you. We make the introduction that actually closes.
  • One warm intro beats ten cold applications. Every time.

2. Customer-facing pitch (long form)

Drop-in for member DMs (when owner has tagged funding-prep), in-portal banners, member-only emails.

Your funding prep file is being assembled. We'll text you a short list of documents to upload to your portal. Once those are in, we'll write your profile narrative and introduce you to the partner we believe fits your profile best. No upfront fees, no stacked applications, no surprises. Watch your inbox.

Shorter variant (push / SMS to a member tagged funding-prep):

You've been tagged for funding prep. Check your portal — we're collecting your handoff package. One warm partner intro is on the way.

Medium variant (member email, ~150 chars):

Your file is ready for a warm partner intro. We package, you keep the capital. Three months bank statements + entity docs + your narrative. Check your portal.

3. Hooks bank — short-form openers

12 hooks. The credit-impaired entrepreneur audience is bombarded by MCA spam — clean, anti-spam positioning wins.

Contrarian / anti-MCA hooks (strongest in this category)

  • "Stop stacking applications. Start stacking your story."

(direct imperative — the audience has been told by every broker to "apply everywhere")

  • "Why one warm intro beats ten cold applications. Every time."

(authority — pair with quick math on credit-pull damage from stacking)

  • "Why MCA brokers don't want you to see this."

(curiosity + contrarian — payoff: we don't take cuts off the funded amount)

  • "Real talk: 'no upfront fee' isn't a feature, it's the standard. Here's what actually matters."

(authority — payoff: the package and the partner fit matter more than the fee structure)

Process / proof hooks

  • "The 5 documents that decide whether you get funded."

(payoff list: bank statements, ID, credit guidance summary, entity docs, operating history — fast list video)

  • "POV: you walked into a funder's office with the package they actually wanted."

(immersive POV — strong on TikTok; pair with desk B-roll, document fan-out)

  • "The story funders actually look for in your bank statements."

(curiosity — payoff: consistent deposits + healthy minimums > raw revenue)

  • "How my customers get funded without ever submitting a cold application."

(proof-of-system — emphasizes the funnel, not the individual deal)

Identity hooks

  • "If you've been turned down by 3+ lenders, watch this."

(strong identity, pain-point open — the exact target audience)

  • "For business owners who keep hearing 'your credit isn't there yet.'"

(identity + bridge to the credit guidance funnel step)

Imperative hooks

  • "Stop applying. Start preparing."

(simple, strong imperative — works as a 3-second hook over text-only video)

  • "The handoff your broker never offered."

(short curiosity — payoff: warm intro, documented rev-share, single-partner focus)

4. Comment & DM reply stock

This is the most-likely-to-go-wrong category for free-writing replies. Stick to the stock.

"How much can I get funded for?"

We don't quote approval amounts. That's the funder's call based on your real package. We've seen a wide range — what matters is the package we hand them is clean and the right partner is matched to your profile. DM for the prerequisite path.

"What rate / APR will I get?"

Same answer — that's the partner's decision based on your profile. Any broker who quotes a rate before they've seen your file is making it up. What we control is the quality of the introduction.

"Can you fund me directly?"

No — and we wouldn't be a good direct funder for you. Our partners have warehouse lines and licensing we don't. Our edge is in qualifying and presenting clients to the right partner, not in carrying the credit risk.

"What's the upfront cost?"

Zero upfront for the handoff itself. The program is gated by completing AIXMOS Credit Guidance ($500–$1k, member-only) — that's the prerequisite. AIXMOS earns a rev-share from the partner on a funded deal, documented in writing before any intro is made.

"How long does this take?"

Depends on where you are in the funnel. If you're not yet an AIXMOS member, that's step one ($97/mo). Credit Guidance is step two ($500–$1k, varies). The funding handoff itself is owner-gated — when your file and story are ready, we tag you funding-prep and the handoff begins.

"What if the first partner says no?"

We reassess together. Sometimes that means more time in credit guidance, sometimes a different partner, sometimes a different funding product entirely. We don't burn through partner relationships shotgunning applications.

"Are you a broker?"

No — we're a referrer. The partner is the regulated lending entity. We package, position, and introduce. Any term sheet you receive comes directly from the partner, not from us.

"What if I have bad credit?"

That's not the start of this conversation — that's what the AIXMOS funnel is for. You'd come in through credit guidance first (deck 2), build the profile, then funding becomes a real conversation. DM us if you want the path.

5. Compliance reminder (creative-specific)

The line we have to hold in this category: we are a referrer, not a lender, not a broker-of-record. Sloppy creative blurs that line and creates regulatory exposure.

Never in any creative:

  • ❌ Quote a funding amount ("get up to $X")
  • ❌ Quote a rate, APR, or term
  • ❌ Imply or state "approval guaranteed"
  • ❌ Describe ourselves as a lender, broker, or "funding company" — the language is handoff, referral, introduction
  • ❌ Show a screenshot of a funded deal amount without legal review (and never without owner sign-off)
  • ❌ Suggest "no credit needed" — funding outcomes depend on the partner's underwriting, including credit

Always:

  • ✅ Position the program as a handoff / introduction
  • ✅ State the prerequisite chain honestly (member → guidance → funding-prep)
  • ✅ Make it clear the partner is the regulated party who issues terms

Channel-specific notes:

  • TikTok / Reels: the algorithm rewards bold claims — resist. Process and identity hooks outperform amount claims in our funnel because they bring qualified leads, not amount-shoppers.
  • Meta ads: Meta's policy on financial services creative is strict and inconsistently enforced. Submit creative to ads review with the longest plain-text version of what we offer; abbreviated versions trigger more rejections.
  • Snap: identity hooks ("if you've been declined…") tend to clear review faster than amount-promise hooks.

Reg context: commercial lending and merchant cash advances are regulated differently by state. Our role as referrer keeps us out of those licensing regimes — but only if our creatives don't accidentally hold us out as a lender or broker-of-record.

Activate GHL Money Collection — the simple runbook

Activate GHL Money Collection — the simple runbook

For: PROJECT X · Date: 2026-06-18 · Agency front: All In One Management Truth: the code rail is ALREADY built (webhooks, payment-sync, checkout-link slots). What's left is clicks inside your GHL account + pasting the live URLs into env. No new code.

⚠️ STEP 0 — Protect the family FIRST (do this before a dollar moves)

Money collected in GHL deposits to whatever bank account the payment processor points at. That single setting is 90% of what shields you and your family.

  • Collecting entity: All In One Management (the agency). Confirm it's the entity on the processor.
  • Deposit account: a BUSINESS bank account for that entity — never a personal account.

(Commingling personal + business is what pierces the veil. Don't.)

  • Firewall the credit lane: credit-guidance money (Moe / Umar's lane) stays tracked separately

and does NOT commingle with your software/agency revenue. Keep his lane fenced.

If any of the above isn't true yet, fix it before going live. This is the protection.

STEP 1 — Connect a payment processor in GHL (10 min)

GHL → Settings → Payments → Integrations → connect Stripe (or your processor). Confirm the connected account deposits to the Step-0 business account.

STEP 2 — Create your products / checkout links (20 min)

GHL → Payments → Products. Create one per thing you sell. Start with the live ones: | Product | Price | Env var to fill (Step 4) | |---|---|---| | AIXMOS Membership | $97/mo | NEXT_PUBLIC_GHL_CHECKOUT_97 | | Credit Guidance | (your price) | NEXT_PUBLIC_GHL_CREDIT_GUIDANCE | | Operator Apply | (your price) | NEXT_PUBLIC_GHL_OPERATOR_APPLY | | OPS / Command / Dealer kits | per ladder | GHL_CHECKOUT_OPS_KIT, GHL_CHECKOUT_COMMAND_KIT, GHL_CHECKOUT_DEALER_BUNDLE | | Consult call | (your price) | GHL_CONSULT_CALL |

"Set anyone up for anything they can pay" = each new offer is just one more Product + link here.

STEP 3 — Wire the 3 workflows + the payment webhook (20 min)

From docs/runbooks/LANE_WIRING_GHL.md and docs/GHL-PIPELINE-SETUP.md:

  1. Create the tags (exact spelling) + the custom field (LANE_WIRING §1–2).
  2. Build W1 (credit-intent handoff), W2 (vehicle-intent handoff), W3 (weekly lane guard).
  3. On every workflow that fires money/events, add a Webhook step → POST https://<your-app>/api/webhooks/ghl

with header x-ghl-webhook-secret: <GHL_WEBHOOK_SECRET> so payments record automatically.

STEP 4 — Paste the live URLs into env (5 min)

For each checkout link from Step 2, set the matching env var in Vercel (source of truth): vercel env add NEXT_PUBLIC_GHL_CHECKOUT_97 production … etc. Also confirm GHL_API_KEY, GHL_LOCATION_ID, GHL_WEBHOOK_SECRET are set. Then re-pull on the carry Mac: vercel env pull .env --environment=production.

STEP 5 — Ship + test ONE real purchase (10 min)

  • bash scripts/ship (owner-gated) to push any link/env changes live.
  • Buy the $97 yourself → confirm: money lands in the business account, the GHL webhook fires,

a payment row appears (your /payments admin page), and the member tag is applied.

  • That single successful loop = the machine works. Everything else is more Products (Step 2).

What I CAN'T do from here (and why)

  • I have no GHL connector in this session → I can't log into your GHL or create products for you.
  • Running ghl-activation-check.mjs would inject a fake $97 payment into your live DB → I won't.
  • The processor + bank routing is yours by law (and by protection) — Step 0 is your hand, not mine.

Once live, the next build (mine)

The TMMT-token ledger (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-tmmt-token-ledger.md) plugs straight into the GHL payment_received webhook → $97 tops up tokens automatically. Say "build the token ledger" when GHL is collecting.

GHL Lane Wiring — Brand Architecture v1.0

GHL Lane Wiring — Brand Architecture v1.0

Implements the exclusive cross-referral lanes from ~/Documents/Business/EMPIRE_BRAND_ARCHITECTURE.md inside GoHighLevel. Exclusivity must be enforced by the system, not by memory.

Lanes:

  • Lane A (lane-a-credit): all credit-repair / funding-readiness demand → Moe Legacy.
  • Lane B (lane-b-transport): all vehicle demand (rental / lease / buy / fleet) → TMMT.

1. Tags (create once, exact spelling)

TagMeaning
lane-a-creditContact routed to Moe Legacy credit/funding lane
lane-b-transportContact routed to TMMT transportation lane
lane-a-source-tmmtLane A client originally sourced by TMMT (retail-minus-COGS economics)
lane-a-source-moe-adsLane A client from Moe's own ad spend (100% Moe's customer)
lane-b-source-moeLane B client referred by Moe Legacy (Operator #1 commission applies)

Keep the existing aff: <code> note attribution untouched — lane tags are additive. Moe's operator attribution for Lane B uses his affiliate code like any operator.

2. Custom field

  • lane_handoff_at (date) — set by the handoff workflows below; lets us measure

lane volume per week for the Friday Recap.

3. Workflows

W1 — Lane A handoff (credit intent detected)

  • Trigger: tag credit-consult-booked added, OR form credit-funding-intake

submitted, OR AI agent flags credit/funding intent.

  • Actions: add lane-a-credit; add lane-a-source-tmmt unless contact already has

lane-a-source-moe-ads; set lane_handoff_at; notify Moe Legacy pipeline (assign to Moe Legacy sub-account/pipeline stage "New — from ecosystem"); SMS continues from the Moe Legacy-branded agent (Riley).

W2 — Lane B handoff (vehicle intent detected)

  • Trigger: AI agent flags "funded / needs vehicle", OR tag funded added, OR rental

inquiry form submitted on a Moe Legacy surface.

  • Actions: add lane-b-transport + lane-b-source-moe (when source is a Moe surface);

set lane_handoff_at; stamp Moe's affiliate code into notes (aff: moe-legacy) if no prior first-touch code exists (first-touch wins — never overwrite an existing code); assign to TMMT RENTALS pipeline stage "New — from Moe Legacy"; agent Taj takes over.

W3 — Lane integrity guard (weekly)

  • Scheduled weekly: list contacts with lane-a-credit not in a Moe pipeline, and

lane-b-transport not in a TMMT pipeline → post count to Slack #ops. Zero is the goal.

4. Attribution rules (must match Operator Agreement §3e)

  1. First-touch is permanent: never overwrite an existing aff: code.
  2. Moe Legacy = Operator #1: Lane B handoffs without prior attribution credit moe-legacy.
  3. TMMT-sourced Lane A clients keep TMMT economics (retail collected by TMMT; Moe invoiced

as COGS) — the lane-a-source-* tags are what the bookkeeping reads each month.

5. Friday Recap additions

Add four numbers: Lane A handoffs, Lane B handoffs, lane-integrity violations, and aff: moe-legacy attributed collections (his commission accrual sanity check).

Kill-switch operations

If anything goes wrong with a tenant, you have four levers:

Soft kill (apps refuse to start, files preserved)

curl -X POST https://tmmt-ops.vercel.app/api/license/revoke \
  -H "X-Admin-Key: $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"organization_id":"<UUID>","mode":"soft"}'

Hard kill (next heartbeat = wipe directive sent to partner Mac)

curl -X POST https://tmmt-ops.vercel.app/api/license/revoke \
  -H "X-Admin-Key: $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"organization_id":"<UUID>","mode":"hard"}'

Restore (undo soft kill)

curl -X POST https://tmmt-ops.vercel.app/api/license/revoke \
  -H "X-Admin-Key: $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"organization_id":"<UUID>","mode":"restore"}'

Operational kill (B3 only — independent of license)

In Vercel: set B3_KILL_SWITCH=1 → redeploy. All B3 webhooks return 503. License layer unaffected. Use this if the SMS agent specifically misbehaves.

Audit + safety verification (run anytime)

-- All three tenants healthy?
SELECT o.name, o.partner_app_slug, l.active, l.kill_command,
       o.llm_daily_cap_usd, o.twilio_inbound_number, o.cal_com_event_link IS NOT NULL AS has_cal,
       o.handoff_slack_webhook IS NOT NULL AS has_slack,
       o.handoff_imessage_target IS NOT NULL AS has_imessage
FROM organizations o
JOIN organization_licenses l ON l.organization_id = o.id
WHERE o.partner_app_slug IN ('aixmos','moe_legacy','tmmt_property')
ORDER BY o.name;

-- 24h activity per tenant
SELECT o.name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.agent_status = 'NEW') AS new,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.agent_status = 'CONTACTED') AS contacted,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.agent_status = 'QUALIFIED') AS qualified,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.agent_status = 'BOOKED') AS booked,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.agent_status = 'CLOSED') AS closed,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.agent_status = 'LOST') AS lost,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.agent_status = 'HUMAN_HANDOFF') AS handoff
FROM organizations o
LEFT JOIN incoming_leads l ON l.organization_id = o.id
   AND l.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
WHERE o.partner_app_slug IN ('aixmos','moe_legacy','tmmt_property')
GROUP BY o.name
ORDER BY o.name;

-- Compliance flag distribution (last 7 days)
SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(compliance_flags) AS flag, count(*)
FROM agent_messages
WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY flag
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

-- Today's LLM spend per tenant
SELECT o.name, sum((payload->>'cost_usd')::numeric) AS spend_usd
FROM audit_events e JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.organization_id
WHERE e.action = 'agent.llm_call' AND e.ts > date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY o.name;
